meta.title: Polipan: self-hosted server panel
meta.description: Open-source panel to deploy and run apps on your own servers. Deploys from Git or Docker, automatic HTTPS, logs, backups and many servers.
nav.label: Main
hero.title: Run your apps on your own servers.
hero.text: Polipan deploys apps from Git or a Docker image, gives them domains and HTTPS, and keeps them running. Open source. One command to install.
hero.note: Use your own domain instead of panel.example.com. Its DNS A record must point to the server.
copy.label: Copy the install command
features.title: What you get
f.deploy.t: Deploy from Git or an image
f.deploy.d: Push code or pick an image. Polipan builds it and starts it.
f.safe.d: Blue-green and canary deploys. Roll back in seconds.
f.https.d: Add a domain. The certificate is made and renewed for you.
f.vars.d: Keep settings for each environment. Secrets are encrypted.
f.watch.d: See what runs. Get a message when something breaks.
f.nodes.d: Join servers in one mesh. Place each app where you want.
f.previews.d: A preview for each branch. Backups of your data on a schedule.
f.team.d: Roles, SSO and API tokens. A CLI and a Terraform provider.
f.lang.d: The panel speaks 12 languages, in a light or a dark theme.
how.title: How it works
how.1.d: Run one command on a server that has a domain.
how.2.d: The installer prints a one-time link. Make the first user.
how.3.d: Connect Git or pick an image. Press Deploy.
example.title: First install
req.title: Requirements
req.1: A Linux server with systemd (x86-64 or ARM64)
req.2: 2 CPU cores and 4 GB of memory or more
req.3: A domain with an A record that points to the server
open.title: Open source
open.text: Polipan is free software under the Apache-2.0 licence. Read the code, report problems and join the talk.
